scripts.test: echo 'Running comprehensive E2E tests...' && npm run test:e2e:all
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:test: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.validate:test-infrastructure: echo '✅ Cypress installed:' && npx cypress version && echo '✅ Test files available:' && ls -la cypress/e2e/ && echo '✅ Test infrastructure ready for beta launch!'
